dlg.backup_prompt_msg:
We strongly recommend backing up your profile before enabling/disabling mods or adjusting load order.
A corrupt write can permanently damage the profile and force you to create a new game save to recover.
We recommend keeping a snapshot before every modification.

se.repair_tip: 💡 Repair zeros engine/transmission/cabin/chassis/wheels wear; refuel sets fuel fields.
